units.co2: ppm, Mauna Loa annual mole fraction
units.error: prediction minus observation in target units
units.mae: mean absolute error in target units
units.rmse: root mean square error in target units
units.bias: mean prediction error in target units
units.rank: dimensionless matrix rank or competition rank as labeled

tables.development_forecasts.csv: 350 origin-target rows,50 per declared model; training years, observed, predicted, error, forecastCO2 input and status
tables.final_forecasts.csv: 70 rows,10 per model from2011; unchanged frozen rules
tables.*_metrics.csv: Overall/per-origin/per-horizon MAE,RMSE,bias; null metric if any required row fails
tables.*_coefficients.csv: Named parameters with units encoded in names; x=decades, fixed C_ref ppm, fitting range/count/method/rank and producer identity
tables.*_residuals.csv: In-sample fitted minus observed in target units; E also log residual; T1 uses observed trainingC for association residual
tables.*_fit_diagnostics.csv: Residual mean/RMSE, lag1 correlation; not selection inputs
tables.production_forecasts.csv: 2022-2100 full7 paths plus last30 selected2; annual central paths
tables.forecast_summary.csv: 2050/2100 values; CO2 signed gap from685 ppm and percent; first-passage reaches-by2050 flag
tables.thresholds.csv: First annual crossing with raw previous/current values; explicit already-reached/no-crossing/invalid statuses; monotonicity,recrossing,later-invalid flags
tables.path_diagnostics.csv: Validity/decrease counts through2300; Q turning year and ppm/year growth
tables.ten_year_changes.csv: 36 intervals ending1969-2004; ten elapsed years; ppm difference and ppm/year growth
tables.relationship_diagnostics.csv: Levels,log levels,linear/quadratic detrending,first differences; units/period/n/intercept/slope/correlation/R2; descriptive only
tables.relationship_series.csv: Residual logC and anomaly, or annual differences; inspectable plot values
tables.historical_error_envelopes.csv: Selected rules B_h=max absolute development error across origins/horizons<=h; final containment separate
tables.production_error_envelopes.csv: 2022-2031 central paths +/- frozen empirical radii; no coverage guarantee
tables.development_error_samples.csv: Five selected-rule origin errors per horizon
tables.horizon_evidence.csv: h1-10 developmentMAE/final absolute error/future year; h1/5/10 flagged
tables.window_sensitivity.csv: Selected unchanged forms full vs1992-2021; forecast difference target units and crossing-date difference years

statuses: OK means numerical execution only. Failed model rows retain null and reason. No causality, policy effect, probabilistic confidence or validated century prediction is asserted.
selection: CO2 developmentMAE ties D,E,Q; temperature only T0 vsT1(selectedCO2), tie T0. Final metrics never select replacement.
